headline: Wardens Gain Ground in Weathered Expanse; Nevish Line Stirs
war_summary: Weathered Expanse has turned since the afternoon edition: three Warden works, four Colonial and two unclaimed now stand where the earlier count gave the Colonials five and the Wardens one. Fourteen actions are logged there in six hours and fifty-nine across the day, chiefly around Spirit Watch and Frostmarch, with the day's cost at 7,508 Colonial and 8,739 Warden and the hourly casualty rate still climbing. The Nevish Line, quiet at midday, has stirred again: two actions in the past two hours and eight across the day, the freshest anywhere on the board, leaving seven Warden works and one unclaimed at Tomb Father. Farranac Coast, likewise long still, reports a Colonial capture at Transient Valley and the heaviest loss rate on the map, above five hundred Colonial and one thousand Warden an hour and rising. Marban Hollow, Olavis Wake and Kuura Strand have fallen quiet in the past two hours after brisk earlier fighting, their lines still mixed; Callahan's Passage and Dead Lands remain costly but static, and the Stlican Shelf continues to bleed.
